note: Public examples of the MSA operator contract. Values are N(0,1) clamped to [-3, 3] (BF16; FP8 caches hold the BF16 values cast to float8_e4m3fn) drawn from each example's seed by msa/check.py; page pools are 1.25x the pages needed and block tables a seeded permutation of the pool. Prefill requests are (context tokens, queries); decode rows are seq_lens, 0 marking a graph-padding row. Each example runs the selection operator, then the attention operator on the reference selection of the same inputs. These examples explain the contract; they do not exhaust it.
